content.intended_use: Selected Algorithm upper bound on squared residual

proofs.locator: Supplement pp.4-8 B.3, Eq.(34)-(47),(50), Lemma 5; main p.3 Corollary 1
map: Normalize R=1. B.3 p.4 combines monotonicity and Lipschitz inequalities so that V_k-V_(k+1)>=Tr(M_k S_k M_k^T), Eq.(34), for V_k=A_k||G(z^k)||^2+(k+1)<G(z^k),z^k-z^0>.

Lemma 5, pp.4-5 and p.8, supplies interval bounds on A_k. Case 1 pp.5-7 chooses tau_k and A_(k+1) by Eq.(40)-(41), uses Eq.(42)-(46) and principal minors to obtain S_k>=0, and uses Eq.(4) to preserve I_k^-.

Starting A_0=alpha/(1+alpha), p.7 final paragraph obtains V_k<=V_0; p.8 Eq.(50), monotonicity against z*, and Young's inequality yield the explicit coefficient. Main Corollary 1 states the permitted interval and 260 constant.
proofs.omitted_details: Source-linked long Proof map, not a local reconstruction. Polynomial identities and principal-minor calculations were read but not independently recomputed. Case 2 is not needed for Eq.(4).
proofs.reading_coverage: Viewed supplement pp.4-8 and read B.3, including Case 1, theorem conclusion and Lemma 5; inspected main p.3 statement. Case 2 was viewed but is not used in this map.

assumptions: L is differentiable and convex in x for each y, concave in y for each x.
G is R-Lipschitz on the entire space and a saddle point exists.
alpha>0 satisfies both 1-3 alpha R-alpha^2 R^2-alpha^3 R^3>=0 and 1-8 alpha R+alpha^2 R^2-2 alpha^3 R^3>=0.
The displayed deterministic updates use exact operator values.
statement.conclusion: Theorem 1: ||grad L(z^k)||^2 <= [4(1+alpha R+alpha^2 R^2)/(alpha^2(1+alpha R))] ||z^0-z*||^2/(k+1)^2. Corollary 1: every 0<alpha<=1/(8R) satisfies Eq.(4), and alpha=1/(8R) gives ||grad L(z^k)||^2 <=260 R^2 ||z^0-z*||^2/(k+1)^2.
statement.objects_and_definitions: L:R^n x R^m -> R; z=(x,y); G=(grad_x L,-grad_y L). Euclidean norm. Fix z^0 and alpha. For every j>=0, a_j=z^j+(z^0-z^j)/(j+2), w_j=a_j-alpha G(z^j), z^(j+1)=a_j-alpha G(w_j). Let z* be any saddle point.
statement.parameter_domains: Positive integers n,m; R>0; alpha>0 subject to Eq.(4); k in Z_>=0.
statement.quantifiers_and_randomness: For every such L, every initial point, every saddle point z*, every admissible fixed alpha, and every integer k>=0; no randomness.
